title: Running Commentary on Torah 29 — Ha'i Gavra d'Azal b'i Ita
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 29 — האי גברא דאזל בעי איתתא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar**: **'Ha'i gavra d'azal b'i ita v'lo ka'yahvei lah — mai chazi d'azal l'heicha d'mi'dal minah?'** — 'A man who went to request a woman and they did not give her to him — what does he see, that he now goes to an even higher-ranking woman?' **Shakal sichta, datza l'sata — lo ayal; dali, datza l'eila — ayal. Amar: ha'i nami mis'ram'ya lah, bas mazlah.** 'He took a peg; drove it downward — it didn't enter; lifted up, drove upward — it entered. He said: so too, this one will be matched to him, bas mazlah.' (Bechoros 8b.)

intermediate.en: **Bechoros 8b**: man requests woman, refused; why go **higher**? R"Y: peg struck low — doesn't enter; struck high — enters. **Ha'i nami mis'ram'ya lah, bas mazlah**.
intermediate.he: **בכורות ח:**: גבר מבקש אשה, סורבה; למה הולך **גבוה יותר**? ר"י: יתד צדה למטה — לא נכנסה; צדה למעלה — נכנסה. **"האי נמי מיתרמיא ליה, בת מזליה"**.

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **d'mi'dal minah** = of higher lineage than the first (if she refused, how much more the higher); **sichta** = peg; **datza** = lowered his hand where there was no hole — didn't enter; **dali datza** = raised his hand and drove where there was a hole — entered.

intermediate.en: Rashi: d'midal=higher lineage; sichta=peg; datza l'sata=lowered (no hole); dali datza=raised to hole.
intermediate.he: רש"י: דמדלי=מיוחסת; סיכתא=יתד; דצה לתתא=השפיל (אין חור); דלי דצה=הגביה לחור.

beginner.en: **Heading**: 'The man who went to request a woman and they did not give her to him...' (repetition of opening phrase, now to be decoded).

**"א. Not every dibbur is called dibbur — dibbur not heard/accepted isn't dibbur: **'ein omer v'ein devarim, bli nishma kolam'** (Tehillim 19:4). Essential acceptance is via the **tov** in the dibbur — everyone desires tov. With tov, it's heard. How is tov placed in dibbur? By **taking the dibbur from the da'as**; then tov is there. Without da'as, no tov — **'gam b'lo da'as nefesh lo tov'** (Mishlei 19:2)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Dibbur heard via tov** ("ein omer... bli nishma kolam," Teh 19:4). Tov from **da'as**: "gam b'lo da'as nefesh lo tov" (Mishlei 19:2).
intermediate.he: **α. דיבור נשמע ע"י טוב** ("אין אומר... בלי נשמע קולם", תה' יט, ד). טוב מ**דעת**: "גם בלא דעת נפש לא טוב" (מש' יט, ב).

scholarly.he: סעיף א. תה' יט, ד; מש' יט, ב.

beginner.en: **"ב. To raise the da'as — via **shvach tzaddikim** (praising tzaddikim). **'K'nesher ya'ir kino'** (Devarim 32:11): **nishra = rucha** (Tikkun 3 of the 11 Tikkunim) = tzaddik (**'ish asher ru'ach bo,'** Bamidbar 27:18). **'Ya'ir kino'** — the mochin awaken from their tardeimah, from **mochin d'katnus/sheinah**. **Kino** = **'keneh chochmah keneh binah'** (Mishlei 4:5) = the mochin. Even malachim, to make their dibbur heard, praise HKBH **'ba'ruach u'mesaserim a'damah'** — the ruach awakens the mochin."**

intermediate.en: **β. Raise da'as via shvach tzaddikim** ("k'nesher ya'ir kino," Dev 32:11; nishra=rucha=tzaddik, Tikkun 3; "keneh chochmah keneh binah," Mishlei 4:5).
intermediate.he: **ב. העלאת דעת ע"י שבח צדיקים** ("כנשר יעיר קינו", דב' לב, יא; נשרא=רוחא=צדיק, תיקון ג; "קנה חכמה קנה בינה", מש' ד, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. דב' לב, יא; מש' ד, ה; תיקון ג.

beginner.en: **"ג. **Bechina of bigadim l'vanim** (white garments) = **tikkun ha'dibbur = malchus peh = bigadim l'vanim**. Must guard bigadim greatly — no stain; the greater the person, the greater the demands. **'Talmid chacham she'nimtza revav al b'gadav chayav misah'** (Shabbos 114a) — for the bigadim themselves judge him, bechina of **dina d'malchusa**."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Tikkun dibbur=bigadim l'vanim (malchus peh)**; guard greatly; "t"ch she'nimtza revav al b'gadav — chayav misah" (Shab 114a) — bigadim judge him (dina d'malchusa).
intermediate.he: **ג. תיקון דיבור=בגדים לבנים (מלכות פה)**; שמירה; "ת"ח שנמצא רבב על בגדיו — חייב מיתה" (שב' קיד.) — בגדים שופטים אותו.

beginner.en: **"ד. Rectifying all aveiros b'peratim is impossible — too many dikdukim. Must rectify **k'lalus ha'gidin = bris** — **'va'yaged lachem es briso'** (Devarim 4:13; Zohar Vayishlach 176). Via tikkun ha'bris (= kelalus ha'gidin), **all lavin transgressed are automatically rectified**, and **livnus** is drawn to them. Called **'Shaddai'** (see above Torah 11 os ג) — **'she'yarah ka'chetz'** (for it shoots like an arrow)."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Tikkun bris=kelalus ha'gidin** (Dev 4:13; Zohar Vay 176) — rectifies all lavin, draws **livnus** (whiteness). Shaddai="yarah ka'chetz."
intermediate.he: **ד. תיקון ברית=כלליות הגידין** (דב' ד, יג; זוה"ק וישלח קעו) — מתקן כל לאוין, ממשיך **לבנונית**. שדי="ירה כחץ".

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. דב' ד, יג; זוה"ק וישלח קעו.

beginner.en: **"ה. **Parnasah b'lo torach** = **'lechem min ha'shamayim'** (Shemos 16:4). Via **tikkun ha'k'lali (=bris)** = **'derech ha'nesher ba'shamayim'** (Mishlei 30:19). **'Ve'ha'man ki'zra gad hu'** (Bamidbar 11:7) — **'zera gad' = tipa chivara'** (Tikkunim 21, 52b) = **'nozlim min Lvanon'** = tikkun habris → parnasah ankled, bechina of man. Parnasah b'tircha u'chveidus = from **not** rectifying the k'lali."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Parnasah b'lo torach** = "lechem min ha'shamayim" (Shem 16:4). Via tikkun k'lali ("derech ha'nesher ba'shamayim," Mishlei 30:19; "zera gad=tipa chivara," Tik 21, 52b; "nozlim min Lvanon"). Tircha=no k'lali.
intermediate.he: **ה. פרנסה בלא טרחא** = "לחם מן השמים" (שמ' טז, ד). תיקון כללי ("דרך הנשר בשמים", מש' ל, יט; "זרע גד=טיפה חיוורא", תיקון כא, נב:; "נוזלים מן לבנון"). טרחא=ללא כללי.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. שמ' טז, ד; מש' ל, יט; במ' יא, ז; תיקון כא נב:.

beginner.en: **"**'Lo sochlu al ha'dam'** (Vayikra 19:26) — through **damim** one causes the Shechinah to be **dam niddah** (**'ir ha'damim,' 'madu'a adom li'l'vushecha,' 'nimtza revav al b'gadav'** — pgam ha'bris = pgam ha'k'lali = pgam ha'bigadim). Via this: **'lo sochlu'** = parnasah b'tircha. **'Lo s'nachashu v'lo s'oneinu'** — they cause **nachash mashich lah l'gabeih**, **shifchah bisha** ruling = **eis ra'ah**."**

intermediate.en: **"Lo sochlu al ha'dam"** (Vay 19:26): damim→Shechinah=dam niddah ("madu'a adom," "revav al b'gadav")=pgam habris=pgam bigadim. "Lo sochlu"=tircha. "Lo s'nachashu"=nachash mashich+shifchah bisha=eis ra'ah.
intermediate.he: **"לא תאכלו על הדם"** (ויק' יט, כו): דמים→שכינה=דם נידה ("מדוע אדום", "רבב על בגדיו")=פגם ברית/בגדים. "לא תאכלו"=טרחא. "לא תנחשו"=נחש משיך+שפחה בישא=עת רעה.

beginner.en: **"ו. As long as **k'lali not rectified** and Shechinah is **"madu'a adom l'lvushecha"** = dam niddah, **dibbur is forbidden**: **'ne'elamti dumiyah'** (Tehillim 39:3). Essential dibbur depends on tikkun k'lali = **'va'yaged lachem es briso.'** Zohar Vayikra 79a/105b: **'Basar d'shachiv R. Shimon havi amar chad l'chavreih: al titen es picha l'hachti es b'sarecha'** — R. Shimon was **kashas ha'bris** (BR 35), **'va'yaged es briso.'**"**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Untreated k'lali → dibbur forbidden** ("ne'elamti dumiyah," Teh 39:3). R. Shimon=kashas ha'bris (BR 35); "al titen picha l'hachti b'sarecha" (Zohar Vay 79a, 105b).
intermediate.he: **ו. ללא תיקון כללי → דיבור אסור** ("נאלמתי דומיה", תה' לט, ג). ר' שמעון=קשת הברית (ב"ר לה); "אל תתן פיך לחטיא בשרך" (זוה"ק ויק' עט., קה:).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. תה' לט, ג; זוה"ק ויק' עט., קה:; ב"ר לה.

beginner.en: **"ז. **Chalei nofel** (epilepsy) R"L = when **damim overcome** and **spurt into the mo'ach**, pressing it; via pressure, the limbs tremble — **mo'ach = sar tzava**; enemy attacks — all limbs tremble. Shechinah falls — **'sukkas David ha'nofeles'** (Amos 9:11). Tikkun k'lali awakens mochin, draws livnus to gidin — **'b'chol eis yihyu begadecha l'vanim'** (Kohelet 9:8) → cures the fall-sickness."**

intermediate.en: **η. Chalei nofel** = damim spurt mo'ach → sar tzava pressed → limbs tremble. Shechinah falls ("sukkas David ha'nofeles," Amos 9:11). Tikkun k'lali→livnus ("b'chol eis yihyu begadecha l'vanim," Koh 9:8).
intermediate.he: **ז. חולי נופל** = דמים מתיזים למוח → שר־צבא נלחץ → איברים רועשים. שכינה נופלת ("סוכת דוד הנופלת", עמ' ט, יא). תיקון כללי→לבנונית ("בכל עת יהיו בגדיך לבנים", קה' ט, ח).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. עמ' ט, יא; קה' ט, ח.

beginner.en: **"ח. **'V'af ki ha'yayin boged'** (Chavakuk 2:5) — **boged = gidin**; via **'holech rachil m'galeh sod'** (Mishlei 11:13), **'nichnas yayin — yatza sod'** (Sanhedrin 38a). Yayin = gidin = hisgavrus ha'damim — **'al tera yayin ki yis'adam'** (Mishlei 23:31) — its end = **dam** (Sanhedrin 70a). Hence: **tirosh** — Chazal (Yoma 76b): **'zachah — na'aseh rosh; lo zachah — na'aseh rash.'** When zakah (purifies damim), yayin→rosh=mochin; otherwise→rash (pauper)."**

intermediate.en: **θ. "V'af ki ha'yayin boged"** (Chav 2:5): boged=gidin; "holech rachil... yayin yatza sod" (Mishlei 11:13; San 38a); "yis'adam→acharis dam" (Mishlei 23:31; San 70a). **Tirosh**: zakah→rosh=mochin; lo zakah→rash (Yoma 76b).
intermediate.he: **ח. "ואף כי היין בוגד"** (חב' ב, ה): בוגד=גידין; "הולך רכיל... יין יצא סוד" (מש' יא, יג; סנ' לח.); "יתאדם→אחריתו דם" (מש' כג, לא; סנ' ע.). **תירוש**: זכה→ראש=מוחין; לא זכה→רש (יומא עו:).

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. חב' ב, ה; מש' יא, יג; יומא עו:.

beginner.en: **"ט. **Masa u'matan b'emunah**. One who trades **b'lo emunah** (sunk in ta'avas mamon, cheating his fellow) arouses **damim**: **'madu'a adom li'l'vushecha'** — causes Shechinah to be dam niddah — **'v'z'havam l'niddah'** (Yechezkel 7:19). **'Damim tartei mashma'** (Megillah 14b; Chidushei Aggados Shabbos 139 'ki kapeichem'): **dam niddah via mamon**. Therefore **gezeilah** = **beged** (**'u'beged bog'dim bagadu,'** Yeshayahu 24:16) = pgam bigadim."**

intermediate.en: **ι. MaU"M b'emunah**: lo emunah + ta'avas mamon → damim → Shechinah=dam niddah ("z'havam l'niddah," Yech 7:19; "damim tartei," Meg 14b). Gezeilah=beged (Yesh 24:16)=pgam bigadim.
intermediate.he: **ט. מו"מ באמונה**: ללא אמונה → דמים → שכינה=דם נידה ("זהבם לנידה", יחז' ז, יט; "דמים תרתי", מג' יד:). גזילה=בגד (יש' כד, טז)=פגם בגדים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ט. יחז' ז, יט; מג' יד:; יש' כד, טז.

beginner.en: **"י. **Klal**: Rectify **tikkun ha'k'lali** first — then all prat rectifies itself automatically. Though k'lali is higher than each perat, each perat's tikkun depends on **mo'ach** — draw **livnus** from mo'ach (**'nozlim min Lvanon'**); to raise the mo'ach is impossible except via tikkun ha'k'lali (**'k'nesher ya'ir kino'**). Hence one must first go to the **highest level** = tikkun ha'k'lali to raise the mo'ach."**

intermediate.en: **κ. Klal**: tikkun ha'k'lali first → perat follows. Perat depends on mo'ach → mo'ach raised only via k'lali ("k'nesher ya'ir kino"). Hence go to **highest level first**.
intermediate.he: **י. כלל**: תיקון הכללי תחילה → פרטים מאליהם. פרט תלוי במוח → מוח מורם רק ע"י כללי ("כנשר יעיר קינו"). לכן לגשת ל**דרגה הגבוהה** תחילה.

beginner.en: **"**Peirush Savei d'Bei Asuna**: **'ha'i gavra d'azal b'i ita v'lo ka'yahvei lah'** = bechina of **'ishah yir'as Hashem'** (Mishlei 31:30) — one who blemished via aveiros, caused dam niddah, **nachash mashich lah l'gabeih**, **perud** between KBH and Shechintei. **'V'lo ka'yahvei lah'** = **'sho'eg yish'ag al naveihu'**. **'Mai chazi d'azal l'heicha d'mi'dal minah?'** = to purify Malchus from the damim, one **goes to a higher level** = **tikkun ha'k'lali** (above 'ishah yir'as Hashem') — from there the perat is rectified."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: "azal b'i ita v'lo ka'yahvei lah"="ishah yir'as Hashem" (Mishlei 31:30) rejected (pgam→dam niddah→nachash→perud). "Azal l'heicha d'mi'dal"=go to higher=tikkun k'lali (above ishah yir'as Hashem).
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: "אזל בעי איתתא ולא יהבי לה"="אשה יראת ה'" (מש' לא, ל) סורב (פגם→דם נידה→נחש→פירוד). "אזל להיכא דמדלי"=גבוה=תיקון כללי (מעל אשה יר"ש).

scholarly.he: מש' לא, ל; כללי מעל הפרט.

beginner.en: **"(Shayach to os ח): a woman with **excessive bleeding** and no **veset** — though yayin harms (yis'adam, dam), her **refuah** is via yayin that a **tzaddik emes** gazed upon — because **einayim = sha'aros**: **'shiv'ah galdei eina'** (Hakdamas Tikkunim 12; Tikkun 70) = **'sheva machl'fos rosho'** (Shoftim 16:13) = the mochin. Sha'aros are **mos'rei mochin**, bechina of 7 machl'fos = 7 midos..."**

intermediate.en: Os ח: **woman with excessive damim** — refuah via yayin a tzaddik emes gazed upon. **Einayim=sha'aros** ("shiv'ah galdei eina," Hakd Tik 12 + Tik 70 = "sheva machl'fos rosho," Shoft 16:13). Sha'aros=mos'rei mochin.
intermediate.he: אות ח: **אשה עם דמים מרובים** — רפואה ביין שצדיק הסתכל בו. **עיניים=שערות** ("שבעה גלדי עינא", הקד' תיקון יב + ע = "שבע מחלפות", שופ' טז, יג). שערות=מותרי מוחין.

scholarly.he: הקד' תיקון יב; ע; שופ' טז, יג.
